rgb_mvtec_multiclass.description: Unimodal RGB multi-class anomaly detection/localization. Paper reference is AnomalDF with and without UCF on MVTec-AD from Table I, with UCF parameter overhead from the efficiency analysis.

image_auroc.description: Image-level AUROC measures whether anomalous images rank above normal images.

pixel_auroc.description: Pixel-level AUROC is the headline localization ranking metric for anomaly maps.

added_params_M.description: Added trainable parameter count penalizes methods that buy accuracy with a much larger filtering module.

image_ap.description: Image-level average precision rewards ranking anomalous images above normal images under class imbalance.

pixel_ap.description: Pixel-level average precision rewards precise anomaly localization when anomalous pixels are sparse.

pixel_f1_max.description: Best pixel-level F1 over thresholds checks whether localization maps can support a usable segmentation threshold.

pixel_aupro.description: Per-region overlap at low false-positive rates measures anomaly localization quality beyond pixelwise ranking.

pixel_aupro_5pct.description: AUPRO at a stricter 5% false-positive-rate cap catches broad heatmaps that localize defects only by flooding normal pixels.

category_mean_image_auroc.description: Unweighted category-mean image AUROC catches methods that improve only the easiest or most common categories.

category_mean_pixel_auroc.description: Unweighted category-mean pixel AUROC checks that localization gains transfer across object and texture categories.
